# Results: pairing filters + macro confluence backtests

*Paper / offline backtests only. No live bots, services, Discord or prod touched. Generated by `research/src/*.py`; raw outputs in `research/out/`.*

## TL;DR / recommendation

* **TEST A: no pairing filter passes the bar** (n>=50, avgR and PF above baseline, t>=1.65 in-sample, holds OOS). Of 3180 filter x cell x mode tests (single filters plus 3 IS-selected combos per system), **0 passed the in-sample bar and 0 passed in-sample + OOS**. The pass bar needs a positive, significant avg R, and every baseline here is flat-to-negative (all 42 baseline cells have avg R between -0.28R and +0.00R over 2023-01 to 2026-10). Filters shave a little off the losses on average (best ~+0.01R on the v4 cells, +0.1 to +0.35R on the 3 desk cells in-sample) but none turns the system positive, and the in-sample gains mostly do not carry to the last-6-months holdout.
* **Do not wire any of these as hard blocks or size weights on the desk or scalp bots on this evidence.** The best-looking in-sample filter (US10Y trend / US10Y-corr-gated on desk cells) is a few dozen trades and sits at t<1.2.
* **TEST B: bottoms are marked, tops are not.** Daily buy zones (+-2 days of an objective swing low) on BTC and XRP are marked by a repeatable confluence: **USDT.D stretched high (RSI/EMA20 distance/upper Bollinger) together with the coin itself being oversold (lower Bollinger / below EMA20)**. Lift 5x to 9x in-sample, ~2.5x to 3.5x out-of-sample (2025-01 on), and it replicates on the other coin. Caveat: USDT.D spikes mechanically when crypto falls, so this is largely a *coincident* oversold read, not a leading one. Macro-only (SPX/NDX/RUT/gold/silver/DXY/US10Y) equity-oversold combos (RUT MACD/RSI low with NDX/SPX 30d ROC low) also mark BTC bottoms (lift ~3 to 5x OOS) but do not hold for XRP. **No sell-zone (top) pattern survived** the permutation + OOS guards on either coin; weekly pivots have too few events (8 per side in-sample) to conclude anything.
* **Practical use:** at most, treat "USDT.D high + coin oversold" as a *zone-awareness* flag for **long-side swing entries**, not a trade trigger. Flagged days sit inside a bottom zone ~65-95% of the time in-sample (only 40-90 days, 11-22 of 39 zones) and ~42-50% OOS vs a 10% base rate, but it catches only ~20-30% of zone days and ~30-40% of OOS zones, and it fires after the move has started. It needs a proper entry study (Test A style) before any use.
* Side note from Test A: across the 36 ungated v4 cells the **long side averages -0.10R and the short side +0.01R** (best short cell +0.12R) in this 2023-26 window; not significant, but it suggests the ungated cells bleed on longs.

## Data sources and method

| Item | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| XRPUSDT / BTCUSDT 15m perp klines + funding | Binance fapi (keyless) | 2022-07-01 to 2026-11-01 (2022-07 to 2022-12 warm-up only; trading window 2023-01-01+) |
| XRP, BTC, XRPBTC, ETHBTC daily | Binance spot (keyless) | XRPUSDT from 2018-05-04 |
| SPX, NDX, RUT, gold, silver, DXY, US10Y | Yahoo via yfinance: ^GSPC, ^NDX, ^RUT, GC=F, SI=F, DX-Y.NYB, ^TNX | gold/silver are futures, not spot; DXY is the ICE index |
| BTC.D, USDT.D, TOTAL, XRP market cap (for XRP.D = XRP mcap / TOTAL) | TradingView CRYPTOCAP via anonymous tvDatafeed | **Unofficial**, unauthenticated feed; free-CoinGecko history is only 365 days and global chart is PRO |
| v4 cell definitions | read-only copy of `brain-trader` (`setups.py`, `research.py`, `live.py`) | replayed, not imported |

**No lookahead:** every filter value is the prior *closed* bar. A daily bar dated D is usable from D+1 00:00 UTC (conservative for macro); weekends/holidays carry Friday's value. Weekly 200MA uses completed weeks only.

**Split:** in-sample (IS) 2023-01-01 to 2026-04-30; out-of-sample (OOS) 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-31 (last 6 months), used only for validation, never for selection. NOTE: requested ~2y of history; I used ~3.8y (2023-01+) so cells can reach n>=50 (OOS n is still small for 4h cells and desk cells: 6 to 20 trades).

**Filter set (each alone, then IS-selected best 2 to 3 combined):** XRP / BTC / XRPBTC trend on D and 4h (close>EMA50 & EMA20>EMA50 => up, mirror => down), price vs weekly 200MA and daily 200MA (+-2% neutral band) for BTC and XRP, XRP.D, BTC.D, USDT.D, ETH/BTC, SPX, NDX, RUT, gold, silver, DXY, US10Y (daily trend; DXY/US10Y/USDT.D/BTC.D(for XRP) are inverted), plus a rolling-30-observation-correlation-gated version of each (trend x sign(corr), neutral when |corr|<0.3). Where no pre-registered sign convention exists (e.g. XRP.D for BTC, BTC.D for BTC) only the correlation-gated form is used.
**Modes:** hard block (long only if state >= 0, short only if <= 0) and size weight (risk x (1 + 0.5 x mean state), i.e. 1.5x with, 1x neutral, 0.5x against).
**Metrics:** after fees 0.06% + slippage 0.05% per side and funding. One open trade per symbol. Welch t (kept vs blocked trades) and paired t on (w-1)xR as the "does it add value, not just cut trades" test.

### Baseline definitions

1. **XRP scalp (brain-trader v4 replay):** 36 cells = 3 timeframes (15m, 1h, 4h) x 2 swing sets (k=3 >=1 ATR; k=5 >=1.5 ATR) x 2 RR (1.5, 2.0) x 3 management (none, BE at 1R, 50% partial at 1R + BE). Stop = just past the last confirmed swing +-0.1 ATR; fee filter (cost/stop <= 0.25R, stop <= 6%); 7-day timeout; intrabar sim on 15m with ambiguous bars stopping first. **The LightGBM P(target) gate is not replayable here (models + 23-pair training data live on beartec-brain), so these are the *ungated* mechanical cells and are not the live system's expectancy.**
2. **Discord-desk mechanical stand-in (BTC, XRP):** my own definition from the desk README rules, not the desk's actual code: daily structure trend (HH/HL vs LH/LL); trade only with HTF trend; enter on a pullback to structure on 15m; stop beyond a real swing (no % stop, no minimum distance); RR measured from that stop; targets T2R, T3R (fixed R) or TSWING (next swing); one trade per idea, held until TP/SL/invalidation. Treat as an approximation.

## TEST B: macro confluence study

**Pivots (objective):** N-bar fractal on daily high/low (N=10), alternating zigzag, a pivot kept only if the swing from the previous opposite pivot is >=3 x ATR14. Weekly (secondary): N=4 weeks, same 3 ATR rule. A *zone* = +-2 days (daily) or +-7 days (weekly) around the pivot's extreme day; bars 3 to 5 days further out are excluded as ambiguous; the last 20 days (daily) / 60 days (weekly) are dropped (pivot not yet confirmable). Non-zone bars are the comparison set.
**Features:** RSI14, MACD histogram/price, distance to EMA20, SMA50, SMA200, slope of SMA50 and SMA200, Bollinger %b and width, ATR% , 30d ROC, and volume ratio where real volume exists (Binance + Yahoo equities/metals only; not TV dominance, DXY, US10Y), on **14 charts**: BTC, XRP, XRP/BTC, ETH/BTC, BTC.D, USDT.D, XRP.D, SPX, NDX, RUT, gold, silver, DXY, US10Y. Each indicator is turned into two flags: top decile / bottom decile of its own trailing 730-obs (504 for equity/macro) percentile rank (prior data only). 326 flags.
**Search:** all singles + pairs (53,301 patterns) plus greedy triples; ranked by z of hits vs base rate. **Guards:** (1) selection on IS only (2019-01 to 2024-12), validation on OOS (2025-01 to 2026-10); (2) max-statistic permutation null (400 circular label shifts, preserves zone clustering, includes the greedy-triple search) => FWER 5/10% critical z; (3) "pass" also requires IS lift>=2 and zones hit in IS (>=8 daily / >=3 weekly), OOS support>=10 days, OOS hits>=3, OOS lift>=1.5 and >=2 distinct OOS zones hit; (4) cross-asset replication (same pattern scored on the other coin's zones). Variants: `all` (all 14 charts), `ex_own` (drops the target coin's own chart), `macro_only` (SPX/NDX/RUT/gold/silver/DXY/US10Y only).
(OOS here is 2025-01 on rather than the last 6 months used for Test A, because 6 months holds only ~2 pivots per side.)

Reading the columns: `prec` = share of flagged days that sit inside a pivot zone (base rate ~10% daily); `lift` = prec / base rate; `recall` = share of all zone days flagged; `zones_hit/zones` = share of distinct pivot zones containing >=1 flagged day (event hit rate); `X_*_lift` = same pattern on the other coin's zones.

## Gaps and caveats

* v4's LightGBM P(target) gate is **not** replayable (models + 23-pair data on beartec-brain). Test A baselines are the ungated mechanical cells; a gated system could behave differently. I did not run anything on beartec-brain; the box was sufficient.
* Discord-desk stand-in is my reading of the README rules, not the desk's code.
* Dominance data (BTC.D, USDT.D, XRP.D via TOTAL) is the TradingView CRYPTOCAP anonymous feed (unofficial); gold/silver are futures; DXY is DX-Y.NYB; US10Y is ^TNX.
* History widened to 2023-01+ (3.8y) vs the requested ~2y. OOS is only ~6 months: 4h cells and desk cells have <50 OOS trades, so OOS "holds" is weak evidence either way.
* Multiple testing: Test A ran several thousand filter x cell x mode comparisons; Test B scanned 53k patterns per study (guarded by a permutation max-stat null, but pivots are few: ~39 to 41 zones per side IS daily, 8 weekly).
* Test B features are coincident (bar t vs a zone around t): it shows *where* bottoms/tops cluster, not a tradable lead. USDT.D is mechanically inverse to crypto price. `ex_own` for XRP still has XRP/BTC and XRP.D, which embed XRP price.
* Macro daily bars carry the Friday value on weekends; macro closes occur before the crypto daily close (no peeking beyond the crypto bar date).
* Zone width (+-2d), N=10, 3 ATR, 10% flag threshold are my choices; not tuned or swept.
